headline: DISSOLVE — the carpet's new spell drowns the map
lede: MAGIC CARPET learned its eleventh spell: DISSOLVE melts the land under your crosshair below sea level — guaranteed, permanent, even on the highest peak. Villages vanish without a burn, and only RAISE can give the ground back.

notes.text: DISSOLVE (cost 40, key -, tray slot 11): a heightmap clamp instead of a crater — whatever the terrain, the wound sinks below the sea and stays there. Learned from an eleventh grimoire in every world.

Ten new carpetcheck gates prove the promises: flood guaranteed at peak 96, cold at the wizard's tower (no topple, no scorch, no wound), creatures swim, huts dissolve without rubble, RAISE drains the flood, same seed same flood. Mutant-tested; autopilot still wins 60/60 seeds.
Slot a shipped WATCH on phones: a big ▶ WATCH button on title screens, a solid 44pt pill in play, and a WATCH row in the pause menu — Jon's 'can't hit Y on a phone' fixed across the arcade.
QA shipped the batch-3 WATCH polish: shared handoff voice, attract hints and one house banner.
